title: My Morning Routine
paragraphs: I get up at six thirty every morning.
First, I drink a glass of warm water.
Then I read English words for ten minutes.
After that, I make a simple breakfast: eggs, bread and milk.
While I eat, I listen to a short English podcast.
It trains my ears every day.
At seven thirty, I leave home for school.
A good morning makes a good day.
translation: 我每天早上六点半起床。首先，我喝一杯温水。然后我读十分钟英语单词。
之后，我做一份简单的早餐：鸡蛋、面包和牛奶。吃饭的时候，我听一小段英语播客。它每天锻炼我的耳朵。
七点半，我离家去上学。美好的早晨带来美好的一天。

title: A Little Robot in the Hospital
paragraphs: In a hospital in Shanghai, a small robot works every day.
It carries medicine from the pharmacy to the nurses.
It never feels tired, and it never forgets the way.
The robot uses cameras to find its road.
When a person walks in front of it, it stops and waits politely.
Patients love to say hello to it.
Engineers say robots will help doctors more in the future.
But robots still need people to guide them.
Machines are fast, yet human care is warm.
translation: 在上海的一家医院里，一个小机器人每天工作。它把药品从药房送到护士站。它从不觉得累，也从不忘记路。
这个机器人用摄像头认路。当有人走在它前面时，它会停下来礼貌地等待。病人们都喜欢跟它打招呼。
工程师说，未来机器人会给医生更多帮助。但机器人仍然需要人来引导。机器很快，而人的关怀是温暖的。

title: Why Leaves Change Color in Autumn
paragraphs: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow, orange and red.
This happens because the nights become longer and cooler.
Green chlorophyll slowly goes away from the leaves.
When the green fades, other colors come out.
Yellow and orange were always inside the leaf.
Red color is new: the leaf makes it on sunny days.
A leaf with bright colors is getting ready to fall.
It gives its energy back to the tree.
Next spring, new green leaves will grow again.
translation: 秋天，叶子变成黄色、橙色和红色。这是因为夜晚变得更长、更凉。绿色的叶绿素慢慢从叶子里消失。
当绿色褪去，其他颜色就显现出来。黄色和橙色本来就藏在叶子里。红色是新产生的：叶子在晴天制造出它。
颜色鲜艳的叶子正准备飘落。它把自己的能量还给大树。明年春天，新的绿叶会再次生长。

title: My Favourite Animal
paragraphs: My favourite animal is the panda.
Pandas live in the mountains of China.
They eat bamboo almost all day.
A baby panda is very small, like a little cat.
It grows fast and becomes black and white.
Pandas look slow, but they can climb trees!
Pandas are a symbol of China.
We should protect them and their forests.
If you see a panda, you will love it.
translation: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫。熊猫生活在中国的大山里。它们几乎一整天都在吃竹子。
熊猫宝宝非常小，像一只小猫。它长得很快，变成黑白两色。熊猫看起来慢吞吞的，但它们会爬树哦！
熊猫是中国的象征。我们应该保护它们和它们的森林。只要你见到熊猫，就一定会爱上它。

title: A Trip to the Supermarket
paragraphs: On Sunday, Mom and I go to the supermarket.
We make a shopping list before we leave.
List in hand, we take the bus there.
First, we get some fruit: apples and bananas.
Then we buy milk, eggs and bread.
Mom also lets me choose my favourite cookies.
At the check-out, we wait in a short line.
The bags are heavy, but I help carry them.
Shopping together is a kind of happiness.
translation: 星期天，妈妈和我去超市。出发前我们先列一张购物清单。拿着清单，我们坐公交车去那里。
首先，我们买一些水果：苹果和香蕉。然后我们买牛奶、鸡蛋和面包。妈妈还让我挑了我最喜欢的饼干。
在收银台，我们排了一小会儿队。袋子很重，但我帮忙提。一起购物，就是一种幸福。

title: The Moon and the Stars
paragraphs: At night, the sky becomes a big dark screen.
The moon and the stars turn on their lights.
Some nights the moon is round; some nights it is thin.
The moon does not make its own light.
It is like a mirror for the sun.
The stars are big suns, very far away.
Long ago, people used stars to find the way at sea.
Sailors called them friends in the sky.
Tonight, look up and say hello to them.
translation: 夜晚，天空变成一块深色的大幕布。月亮和星星打开了自己的灯。有些夜晚月亮是圆的，有些夜晚是弯弯的。
月亮自己并不发光。它像一面太阳的镜子。星星其实是很远很远的大太阳。
很久以前，人们在海上用星星辨认方向。水手们把星星叫做天上的朋友。今晚，抬头向它们问声好吧。

title: Protecting Our Blue Planet
paragraphs: The ocean covers more than seventy percent of our planet.
It produces much of the oxygen we breathe and feeds billions of people.
Yet human activity is pushing it to the edge.
Plastic waste has become a serious problem.
Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in the sea.
Sea animals often mistake plastic bags for food, which can be deadly.
Governments around the world are now taking action.
Some countries have banned single-use plastic bags.
Scientists also suggest recycling and cleaning up beaches.
Small daily choices, like carrying a cloth bag, can make a difference.
translation: 海洋覆盖了我们星球百分之七十以上的面积。它产生我们呼吸的大部分氧气，养育着数十亿人。然而人类活动正把它推向极限。
塑料垃圾已成为严重问题。每年有数百万吨塑料进入大海。海洋动物常常把塑料袋误当成食物，这可能是致命的。
世界各国政府正在采取行动。一些国家已禁止使用一次性塑料袋。科学家还建议回收利用和清理海滩。像自带布袋这样的日常小选择，也能带来改变。

title: Learning a Language in the Digital Age
paragraphs: Twenty years ago, language learners depended on paper dictionaries and cassette tapes.
Today, a phone can check a word in one second and read it aloud.
Technology has completely changed the way we study.
Apps remind us to practice every day and track our progress.
Online videos let us hear real conversations from around the world.
Some learners even chat with artificial intelligence to improve their speaking.
However, experts warn that tools alone are not enough.
Learning still requires patience, review and real communication.
The best result comes from combining technology with daily effort.
translation: 二十年前，语言学习者依赖纸质词典和磁带。今天，一部手机一秒钟就能查一个词并朗读出来。科技彻底改变了我们的学习方式。
应用提醒我们每天练习并记录进度。在线视频让我们听到世界各地的真实对话。一些学习者甚至和人工智能聊天来提高口语。
然而，专家警告：只有工具是不够的。学习仍需要耐心、复习和真实的交流。最好的结果来自科技与每日努力的结合。

title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
paragraphs: In many countries, students wear the same clothes at school.
People have discussed this tradition for years, and opinions differ.
Supporters say uniforms make everyone equal.
When nobody wears expensive brands, students focus more on study than on clothes.
Uniforms also build a feeling of belonging to the school.
Critics, however, believe uniforms limit personal freedom.
Teenagers want to express themselves, and clothes are one way to do that.
A fixed uniform may also cost families extra money.
Perhaps the best answer lies in balance.
Schools could allow free dress on some days while keeping uniforms on others.
translation: 在许多国家，学生在学校穿同样的衣服。人们围绕这一传统讨论了很多年，看法不一。
支持者说校服让每个人平等。当没有人穿名牌时，学生会更专注于学习而不是衣着。校服还能建立对学校的归属感。
而批评者认为校服限制了个人自由。青少年想要表达自我，衣服是方式之一。固定款式的校服也可能让家庭多花钱。
也许最好的答案是平衡：学校可以部分日子允许自由着装，其余日子穿校服。

title: Food Miles and Fresh Vegetables
paragraphs: Have you checked where your dinner comes from?
The term "food miles" describes how far food travels before it reaches your plate.
Long journeys need planes, ships and trucks, all of which burn fuel and produce carbon dioxide.
A strawberry flown across the world can leave a bigger footprint than one grown nearby.
Local markets offer a simple solution.
Vegetables sold there are usually fresher because they are picked recently.
Buying local food also supports small farmers in your area.
Next weekend, try visiting a farmers' market.
You may eat healthier and help the planet at the same time.
translation: 你查过晚餐食材的来源吗？「食物里程」这个词描述的是食物到达你餐桌前走了多远。
长途运输需要飞机、轮船和卡车，它们都燃烧燃料、排放二氧化碳。一颗空运 across 世界的草莓，留下的碳足迹可能比本地种植的大得多。
本地市场提供了一个简单的解决办法。那里卖的蔬菜通常更新鲜，因为刚采摘不久。购买本地食物还能支持当地的小农户。
下周末，试着逛逛农夫市集吧。你可能吃得更健康，同时也帮了地球一把。

title: Why We Sleep
paragraphs: We spend about one third of our lives asleep, but why?
Scientists are still exploring this question, and recent studies offer interesting answers.
During sleep, the brain is not resting completely.
It sorts the memories of the day, keeping what matters and dropping what does not.
That is why a good night's sleep helps students remember what they learned.
Sleep also repairs the body.
Growth hormone is released mainly at night, and the immune system becomes stronger while we dream.
Most teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep every night.
Putting the phone away one hour before bed may be the simplest way to get them.
translation: 我们一生约三分之一在睡觉，这是为什么？科学家仍在探索这个问题，最近的研究给出了有趣的答案。
睡眠中，大脑并没有完全休息。它整理一天的记忆，留下重要的，丢弃不重要的。这就是为什么睡个好觉能帮助学生记住学过的内容。
睡眠还能修复身体。生长激素主要在夜间分泌，做梦时免疫系统也会变强。
大多数青少年每晚需要八到十小时睡眠。睡前一小时把手机放远一点，也许就是获得睡眠最简单的办法。

title: The Rise of Remote Work
paragraphs: Ten years ago, working from home was a rare privilege.
After 2020, it became normal for millions of office workers around the world.
Remote work saves commuting time, which employees can spend with family or on hobbies.
Companies also save money on offices, and they can hire talented people from any city.
Still, the practice brings challenges.
Some workers feel lonely without colleagues around them.
It is also harder to separate work life from home life when both happen in the same room.
Many companies now choose a mixed model: a few days at the office, a few days at home.
The future of work may be neither fully remote nor fully traditional.
translation: 十年前，在家工作还是少见的特权。2020 年之后，它成为全球数百万上班族的常态。
远程办公省去了通勤时间，员工可以把时间留给家人或爱好。公司也节省了办公室开支，还能从任何城市招到人才。
不过，这种做法也带来挑战。有些员工在身边没有同事时感到孤独。当工作和生活发生在同一个房间，也更难把两者分开。
许多公司现在选择混合模式：几天在办公室，几天在家。未来的工作方式也许既不会完全远程，也不会完全传统。
